-- Remover entradas de squadPlayers onde squadId = 0 (bug do batch insert)
DELETE FROM squadPlayers WHERE squadId = 0 OR squadId IS NULL;

-- Ver squads existentes para diagnóstico
SELECT s.id, s.teamName, s.userId, COUNT(sp.id) as playerCount
FROM squads s
LEFT JOIN squadPlayers sp ON sp.squadId = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.teamName, s.userId;
